distilled_patterns.description: Agents consistently contaminate final answer submissions with explanatory prose, preambles ('Based on...'), and conversational commentary instead of returning pure entities, triggering strict benchmark string-match evaluation failures.
distilled_patterns.effect: Eliminates repeated zero-reward evaluations across 10 cases by enforcing zero-preamble, direct entity-only strings in the finish argument.

distilled_patterns.description: Multi-hop browsing queries fail when agents submit brittle full-sentence questions or complex boolean operators into search instead of decomposing into sequential entity lookups.
distilled_patterns.effect: Prevents empty search results and query-loop budget depletion on multi-hop cases such as 802 and 805.

distilled_patterns.description: Artificially low step caps (e.g. 18 steps) force premature fallback submissions before multi-hop evidence is gathered, whereas tasks succeeding on multi-hop questions reliably converge at 20-24 steps.
distilled_patterns.effect: Aligns the convergence schedule with the true 25-step environment limit, providing adequate search depth before mandatory submission at steps 22-23.
